description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'ThingTooManyModifyingRequestsException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. The exception indicates that too many modify requests have been made to a specific 'Thing' in a short period, encapsulating details like headers, message, description, cause, and related URI. It includes factory methods for creating instances from messages and JSON representations, as well as a builder class for constructing exceptions with fluent API support.
